We propose ConvGQR, a new Generative Query Reformulation framework for Conversational search. It combines query rewriting with query expansion. Two generative PLMs are used to generate a rewritten query and expansion terms for both training and inference.

We aim to design a query reformulation model to transform the current query q i together with the conversational historical context H k into a de-contextualized rewritten query for conversational search. A first desired behavior of query reformulation is to produce a similar rewritten query as a human expert.
